catalysts.headline: Stock gave back most of the prior session's takeover-speculation-driven gains as investors refocused on awaited VK2735 Phase 3 (VANQUISH) topline data, expected in 2027; no company confirmation of any acquisition process

At ObesityWeek 2026, Viking presented VENTURE Phase 2 analysis: 74% of participants on weekly subcutaneous VK2735 improved by at least one BMI category after 13 weeks, vs. 15% on placebo; none of the VK2735-treated participants increased their BMI category

At ObesityWeek 2026, Viking presented Phase 3 VANQUISH-2 baseline characteristics (adults with overweight/obesity and type 2 diabetes), describing the randomized population as representative of the broader US adult population with BMI ≥27 and T2D

VK2735 (obesity) data/poster presentations scheduled at ObesityWeek 2026 in Washington, D.C. (running 2026-11-14 through 2026-11-17); Viking management also scheduled a fireside chat at the UBS Global Biopharma Conference on 2026-11-17
catalysts.impact: Visibility/investor-conference event for the VK2735 obesity franchise; pivotal Phase 3 data are not expected until 2027

catalysts.headline: Viking Therapeutics scheduled to present two VK2735 posters at ObesityWeek 2026 (Washington, D.C., Nov 14-17, 2026): Phase 3 VANQUISH-2 baseline data and Phase 2 VENTURE results
Shares rallied on renewed, unconfirmed takeover/M&A speculation (reportedly tied to chatter from M&A-focused outlet Betaville); no bidder or deal terms confirmed by the company or any primary source
catalysts.impact: +5.95% to $29.22; some secondary sources (unreconciled) describe a much larger spike to the $35-42 range around this window

catalysts.headline: Viking announced participation in November/December healthcare investor conferences, including a UBS fireside chat (London, Nov 17) and a Jefferies fireside chat (New York, Dec 2)

Viking Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 results: net loss widened to $183.2M (-$1.55/share, GAAP) on rising trial spending; cash/investments stood at $960M after a capital raise reported as ~$550M net proceeds by one source and ~$575M by another (combined common stock and convertible note offerings); VK2735 Phase 3 obesity programs continuing to advance. Company said available funds should support operations through at least 2027-12-31.
catalysts.impact: Widening losses reflect ramp in late-stage trial costs; runway extended via the Q3 capital raise.

catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: net loss widened to $183.2M (-$1.55/sh) from $90.8M (-$0.81/sh) a year earlier, driven by higher VK2735 Phase 3 trial and manufacturing spending; cash and short-term investments rose to $960M (from $502M at 2026-06-30) following a September 2026 capital raise; company guided cash runway through at least 2027-12-31
catalysts.impact: Confirms near-term funding for the ongoing Phase 3 SUNRISE (oral VK2735) and injectable VK2735 programs in obesity

catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: net loss widened to $183.2M (-$1.55/diluted share) from -$0.81/share in Q3 2025; nine-month net loss $469.5M (-$4.03/share) vs -$1.80/share a year earlier; R&D expense $166.8M vs $90.0M; cash/cash equivalents/short-term investments ~$960M including ~$550M net proceeds from a September 2026 financing; VK2735 Phase 3 (VANQUISH) programs continuing to advance

Viking Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 results after market close: net loss widened to $183.2M (vs $90.8M in Q3 2025); 9-month net loss $469.5M. Pipeline update: oral VK2735 SUNRISE Phase 3 program initiated; subcutaneous VANQUISH 1/2 Phase 3 trials continuing on track, expected completion 2027; VK3019 (amylin agonist) Phase 1 single-ascending-dose study nearing completion, 28-day multiple-ascending-dose study expected to start Q1 2027.

Viking Therapeutics announced it will report Q3 2026 results after market close on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30pm ET

Viking announces positive topline results from VK2735 maintenance-dosing study: 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at week 33 (no plateau observed); patients switching from weekly to every-other-week dosing retained up to 97% of prior weight loss, and up to 90% with monthly dosing (vs ~61% retention on placebo); GI side effects during maintenance similar to placebo
catalysts.impact: Stock surged intraday; reported magnitude ranges +27% to +39% depending on source/timing (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: Truist Securities called the VK2735 maintenance readout a 'best case scenario'; Oppenheimer raised price target to $120 from $100 (Outperform)

Viking filed Form S-3ASR shelf registration enabling future capital raises to fund VK2735 subcutaneous and oral Phase 3 programs; company also completed a ~$159.6M follow-on equity raise around this period
catalysts.impact: dilutive financing event; extends balance sheet

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: GAAP EPS -$1.10 (beat consensus -$1.21 by $0.11); $502M cash and investments at June 30, 2026, which the company said funds operations into 2028; VANQUISH 1 (obesity) and VANQUISH 2 (obesity + T2D) Phase III trials for VK2735 remain on track and fully enrolled; oral VK2735 Phase III expected to start Q4 2026
Viking Therapeutics reports Q2 2026 results: GAAP EPS of -$1.10 vs. -$1.21 consensus (beat)
